title: Hermite basis vectors
statement: For every natural number $n$ and multi-index $\alpha:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb N$, the Hilbert basis vector indexed by $\alpha$ is the $L^2$ equivalence class of the Hermite function indexed by $\alpha$, with respect to the product of $n$ standard Gaussian measures.
